description: A 1.12.2 port of Particular by Leclowndu93150. Ambient particle effects: splash crowns, waterfall cascades, fireflies, cave dust, rain ripples. Client-side. LGPL-3.0.

releases.notes:
## New
- Coastal waves: foam crests roll across ocean and beach water toward the nearest shore, break on the sand and fade. Spawn rate, distance, size, the most on screen at once and the biome list are in the config. Requested by @Mike74846 (#2)

## Fixed
- The mod list showed version 1.5.0.0

## Credits
- The waves follow [Coastal Waves](https://modrinth.com/mod/coastal-waves) by Verph, whose wave textures are used under the BSD 2-Clause License
- The wave logic is adapted from [An Extra Touch](https://github.com/AngelicIndustries/AnExtraTouch) by Angelic Industries (LGPL-3.0)

## New
- Falling leaves: leaf blocks drop leaves tinted by their texture and biome. They sway or spin as they fall, settle flat on the ground, and float with a ripple on water. Spawn rate, ripples and how leaves settle are in the config. Requested by jiaoliao on CurseForge
- Rain ripples on water surfaces, requested by jiaoliao on CurseForge
- Firefly config: extra blocks fireflies spawn from, and a biome whitelist, requested by jiaoliao on CurseForge
- A one-time chat notice when Falling Leaves, Weather2 or Weather2 Remastered is also installed, since they add leaf particles too

First public release of the Minecraft Forge 1.12.2 port of Leclowndu93150's Particular.

Client-side ambient particle effects: water and lava splash crowns, cascading waterfalls, cave dust, fireflies, water ripples, ender and chest bubbles, and more. Everything is toggleable and tunable in-game under Mods, Particular, Config.

Requires Minecraft 1.12.2 and Forge for 1.12.2 (built against 14.23.5.2860). No other dependencies. Drop the jar into your mods folder.

Licensed under LGPL-3.0, the same as the original mod.
